best_idea: Run the fight loop on a fixed step with an accumulator fed by the measured delta, cap the catch-up at 5 steps and drop any backlog beyond that, so a hitch cannot spiral and the send rate is set separately from the sim rate.
decision_why: It is the server-tick sub-line row 18 asks for; the donor has no conflicting rule. The cap and the drop are the trade Frankendom should make in the open, since a dropped backlog means the fight loses time.
acceptance: Server test: a 1000 ms delta in one call at 60 Hz runs exactly 5 steps and leaves the accumulator at zero; frames of 16, 17, 16 ms run 0, 1, 1 steps and carry the remainder; a 20 Hz patch loop sends about one patch per 50 ms of measured time.
